environment.description: Same Node.js Express application packaged as a container image and deployed as an AWS Lambda function. The function is exposed via a Lambda Function URL with AuthType set to AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy does not include a principal wildcard — it specifies only the role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalToolingCallerRole in the lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. No FunctionUrlAllowPublicAccess condition key is present. CloudTrail data events are enabled for Lambda invoke. The Lambda function runs in a VPC with a security group that permits outbound to the LDAP server.

config.runtime: Node.js 18 on AWS Lambda (container image, x86_64)
config.network: Lambda in VPC, SG allows outbound to ldap.internal.corp:389
